MV.materialCaution: The English reading is an unofficial paraphrase of official Dhivehi. The registered-article definition enumerates plants/products, storage, packing, conveyances, containers, soil and other organisms/articles capable of carrying/spreading pests and needing phytosanitary measures. Read in the statutory risk-control context; no unsupported claim that every ordinary clean food pouch inherently requires a phytosanitary certificate. If a contrary current specific commodity measure is subsequently found, it would control.
